title: SECURITY: an unknown definition id answers 404 on read, activate and delete and changes nothing
description: The administrator reads, activates and deletes a definition id that does not exist in the tenant (the all-zero id): each is a 404 and nothing changes. A foreign tenant's id is indistinguishable from an unknown one (INV-5); the two-token half is covered by the Elixir tests. The public address (unknown kind and handle, 404) is not played here: the static check knows no public route.
